summary: IdentityDocumentServices lets apps present mobile identity documents (driver licence, ID card, passport-derived documents) through the system wallet and the Digital Credentials API in browsers. It depends on Apple's document provider registration and iCloud, and BifrOSt has no identity document or Digital Credentials support.

features.note: System wallet registration for government-issued documents
Digital Credentials API flow for browsers

features.apple: Verifying a mobile document from a passport

features.note: Only meaningful with the flow above

gaps: No identity document registration or Digital Credentials web presentment (n/a: depends on Apple wallet documents and iCloud)
